**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace contains exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there is one image file.

What it shows (faithful to the C4 model):
- **Patron** (Person, C4 blue `#0E70C1`) → **Library** (Software System, `#1168BD`), left-to-right layout
- Relationship arrow labeled *"Browses the catalogue through"* with technology *[HTTPS]*
- Element descriptions, type labels, and a legend — matching the C4-PlantUML export of the view

One transparency note: this sandbox has no internet access and no rendering runtimes (no Java/Node/Python/Graphviz, and the structurizr MCP server only exports text formats like PlantUML/Mermaid), so I couldn't run a standard renderer like `structurizr-cli` or PlantUML. Instead I generated the SVG directly from the view data exported by the structurizr tools, using standard C4 notation and colors. The file is valid XML and opens in any browser or image viewer. If you'd prefer PNG, it can be produced by opening the SVG in a browser or running `rsvg-convert`/Inkscape on a machine with network access.
